_comment: Overlay on the general base for the 'labor' domain. Polarity is from a worker view. Unemployment terms are neutral because direction ("unemployment fell") decides the polarity and a word-level lexicon cannot see it. 'positive'/'negative' entries re-file a term (removing it from the opposite list); 'neutral' drops a base term because its polarity is not stable here. STARTER lexicon, unvalidated against labelled data; extend before relying on it.
